name: Web Listing Circle Connector
author: wlcteam

sections.description:
Web Listing Circle Connector is a powerful plugin for business owners, freelancers, and local service providers. Connect your site with Web Listing Circle to:

  • Submit your business listing with one click
  • Connect securely using your API key
  • Display a “Proudly Listed” badge on your website
  • Boost SEO with increased visibility through local listings

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to submit business listing data to WebListingCircle.com.

It sends the following fields when a user submits the listing form:
– Name
– Category
– Address
– Phone
– Email
– Website
– Description

This data is sent via secure HTTPS to:
https://weblistingcircle.com/wp-json/wlc/v1/create-listing

This service is provided by Web Listing Circle.
– Terms of Use: https://weblistingcircle.com/terms-of-service/
– Privacy Policy: https://weblistingcircle.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/web-listing-circle-connector directory, or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Web Listing Circle to configure your API key and submit your listing.
sections.faq:
Is it free to list?

Yes. Web Listing Circle offers a free basic listing plan for all users.

Can I show the badge on my homepage?

Yes! Use the shortcode [wlcc_badge] anywhere you’d like to display your badge.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release with listing submission, API key integration, and shortcode-based badge display.
